business_problem: Every Cure needed to evaluate tens of millions of drug-disease combinations fast enough to find overlooked repurposing opportunities, which required a unified biomedical data foundation instead of long, batch-style research cycles.
solution_summary: Every Cure uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Every Cure needed to evaluate tens of millions of drug-disease combinations fast enough to find overlooked repurposing opportunities, which required a unified biomedical data foundation instead of long, batch-style research cycles. BigQuery houses large biomedical knowledge graphs and lets the team score and query drug-disease relationships at scale, serving as the storage layer. Cloud Storage stores the platform’s biomedical data assets alongside the knowledge-graph foundation, serving as the storage layer. Gemini quantifies evidence across published research, clinical data, and molecular biology and helps triage the most promising predictions, serving as the compute layer. Google Cloud GPUs accelerate the prediction pipeline so experiments that once ran for months can complete in hours, serving as the compute layer.
